Configure a 2D (one-cell-thick) transient, incompressible, laminar flow-past-cylinder simulation using pimpleFoam.
The mesh has a single cell in the spanwise (z) direction.
In constant/polyMesh/boundary, the frontAndBack patch is defined with type empty.
In 0/U, the frontAndBack boundary condition is type empty.
In 0/U, the inlet boundary condition is type fixedValue with a uniform inlet velocity.
In 0/U, the outlet boundary condition is type zeroGradient.
In 0/U, the cylinderWall boundary condition is type noSlip.
In 0/p, the frontAndBack boundary condition is type empty.
In 0/p, the inlet boundary condition is type zeroGradient.
In 0/p, the outlet boundary condition is type fixedValue with a uniform reference pressure of zero.
In 0/p, the cylinderWall boundary condition is type zeroGradient.
No turbulence model is used; the simulation is purely laminar.
The transportProperties file specifies a constant kinematic viscosity nu.
The fvSchemes and fvSolution files use standard settings appropriate for a transient incompressible laminar solve with pimpleFoam.
The case runs with a fixed time step and a user-defined number of time steps or run time, with a fixed number of outer and non-orthogonal corrector iterations per PIMPLE loop.
